sections.title: Summary
sections.text: The model scores this case positive with probability 99.2% (logit 12.61).

sections.title: Evidence
sections.text: The strongest contributions come from patches 1268, 1227, 1579. Patch 1268 alone adds 1.26 to the logit.

sections.title: What-if
sections.text: Removing the top 5 patches changes the probability from 99.2% to 98.2%.

sections.title: Limits
sections.text: Decision-support demo, not a medical device. A specialist must review the highlighted regions.
